import type {
  Organization,
  OrganizationApi,
  OrganizationManagementApi,
  OrganizationUser
} from "./contracts"

/** 显式组织与成员 fixture 保持规范化；切换不会自动创建组织或授予 owner。 */
export function createOrganizationMock(
  actor: () => string | null,
  initial: readonly Organization[],
  users: readonly OrganizationUser[],
  canManage: (user: OrganizationUser) => boolean = () => false
): OrganizationApi & OrganizationManagementApi {
  const organizations = new Map(initial.map((row) => [row.id, { ...row }]))
  const current = new Map<string, string>()
  /** 每次操作重新校验当前账号的成员关系，页面不能伪造操作者。 */
  function membership(id: string) {
    const accountId = actor()
    const user = users.find((row) => row.accountId === accountId && row.organizationId === id)
    const organization = organizations.get(id)
    if (!accountId || !user || !organization) throw new Error("organization_denied")
    return { accountId, user, organization }
  }
  /** 同步快照与写入在同一服务事务执行，避免校验和提交之间产生异步空隙。 */
  function snapshot() {
    const accountId = actor()
    if (!accountId) throw new Error("identity_required")
    const available = users
      .filter((row) => row.accountId === accountId)
      .map((user) => {
        const organization = organizations.get(user.organizationId)
        if (!organization) throw new Error("organization_invalid")
        return { ...organization, user: { ...user } }
      })
    const selected = current.get(accountId)
    const personal = available.find((row) => row.ownerAccountId === accountId)
    return {
      current:
        available.find((row) => row.id === selected)?.id ??
        personal?.id ??
        available[0]?.id ??
        null,
      available
    }
  }
  return {
    /** 成员关系属于账号，读取不依赖目标组织中的业务权限。 */
    async read(signal) {
      signal?.throwIfAborted()
      return snapshot()
    },
    /** 切换仅选择已存在的成员关系，相同目标不产生写入。 */
    async switch(id) {
      const { accountId } = membership(id)
      const context = snapshot()
      if (context.current === id) return
      if (actor() !== accountId) throw new Error("organization_superseded")
      current.set(accountId, id)
    },
    /** API 边界同时复核活动组织、拥有者账号与组织用户角色。 */
    async rename(id, input) {
      const { accountId, user, organization } = membership(id)
      const context = snapshot()
      if (
        actor() !== accountId ||
        context.current !== id ||
        user.role !== "owner" ||
        !canManage(user) ||
        organization.ownerAccountId !== accountId
      )
        throw new Error("organization_denied")
      const name = input.trim()
      if (!name || name.length > 60) throw new Error("organization_name_invalid")
      organizations.set(id, { ...organization, name })
    }
  }
}
